headline: “E20 Petrol Increased Burden on Common People, Benefit to Producers”: Congress Sharply Attacks Central Government
summary: The Congress Party said the subsidy released for E20 blended petrol benefited ethanol producers rather than ordinary citizens. Congress leader Jairam Ramesh made the claim against the central government.
why: E20 fuel blends ethanol with petrol, so subsidy policy shapes ethanol producers' margins and fuel pricing. Biofuel policy is a recurring political and economic issue in India.
